description:
Ask the other members of a workspace to pay you amount_usdc (e.g. "5") in USDC at your receiving address
        pay_to (0x..., the same address works on every supported network). memo says what it's for; ref can point at a
        file, e.g. deals/site.md#final. hashn logs it as payments/<request_id>.md in the workspace and updates that
        entry when it's paid. hashn never holds the money and attaches no meaning to it.
name: request_payment
